title: Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi takes charge of the Union Ministry of Education
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Education

Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi takes charge of the Union Ministry of Education

Shri Joshi holds a review meeting with senior officials of the Ministry

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
26 JUL 2026 2:00PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi officially took charge of the Ministry of Education at Kartavya Bhavan today. The Minister also holds charges of the Union Ministries of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, and New and Renewable Energy.

Shri Joshi chaired a review meeting of the Ministry in which he reviewed the implementation of various Schemes and other initiatives. Union Minister of State of Education Shri Jayant Chaudhary also attended the review meeting.

Secretary, Department of Higher Education, Dr Vineet Joshi, and Secretary, Department of School Education and Literacy, Shri T. K. Anil Kumar, along with senior officers of the Ministry were present.
